Subject: Request to rebook: security intake + DPA review

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note — our SOC 2 lead just flagged a conflict for the walkthrough we had on Thursday (Oct 23). They need to move the session to next week. Apologies for the short notice.

Proposed windows from our side:
- Tue, Oct 28: 13:00–15:00 PT (90–120m ok)
- Wed, Oct 29: 07:00–09:00 PT (APAC-friendly)

We still want the same agenda: SOC 2 controls overview, DPA review (high-level), and a short pen-test scoping conversation. Attendee list attached (Acme_Attendee_Roster_v2.xlsx).

Please confirm what works, and if Redwood needs to change staffing on your side I can pull additional folks from legal/infosec. We’d also like to get any pre-read materials earlier this week if possible.

Thanks,

Hi Jillian — thanks for the heads up and the roster.

We can accommodate both windows. My proposed plan:
1) Aim for Tue, Oct 28 13:00 PT as primary. That gives our SOC engineer time to prep.
2) If needed, fallback to Wed, Oct 29 07:00 PT for APAC coverage.
3) We'll run a 90-minute intake: 45 minutes controls/DPA overview, 30 minutes pen-test scoping, 15 minutes open Q&A and next steps.

Action items from our side before the call:
- I'll send a short pre-read (Redwood_Security_Intake_Checklist.pdf) by EOD Wed.
- Irene will prepare our service architecture diagram and a short summary of logging/retention settings.
- Ben will confirm procurement/contract contact for any redlines.

Ben / Irene — can you confirm availability for Tue 13:00 PT? If we lock that, I will send a calendar invite and a DocuSign link for a standard DPA addendum that Acme can sign ahead of the walkthrough.

Jillian — please let us know if any additional Acme stakeholders (legal or pen vendor) need to be on the invite.

Best,
